The '''Antemeridias system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Antemeridian sector/Legends|Antemeridian sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Antemeridias]].<ref name="PoT" />
